wish: Happy birthday,  Ayesha! I'm soooooo happy for your special day, you know i mean it~ i want this  to be a new beginning for you, a time where you are never sad , never crying and always happy!! I miss that smile soo much 😭💗
letter:
My dearest Ayesha

HAPPY BIRTHDAY AGAIN!~ I know it's like 3rd time now?😭 But i just want you to have a veryyy happy birthday..

and THANK YOU MOMMY, for your birthday wishes on 8th of nov.. I am sorry that I wasn't awake to see your texts and calls....i regretted not being awake so much that day.....yet i knew I missed my opportunity to reply to you...
I just didn't had any motive to stay awake ,even on my birthday since....i don't really have anyone who cares about me or my birthday like you did....no one to make me feel excited for my own birthday lol,   
And about us not understanding each other? I don't think that was the case...we did understand...that's why we felt the pain even more , isn't that right? I don't hate you, nor will i ever be able to forget you, no one will ever replace your place in my heart. Never.....

I know throughout the years i have made plenty of mistakes , received plenty of forgiveness from you, and i hope you don't regret those because i can never regret it even once , not you...never you 

Ugh so much~ heyy baby how is it going? Has my little kitten finally found the right way?...i hope you said yes~ because I'm soo glad that you are doing the things you like and cherish now.. it doesn't has to be anything huge and all...

And mommy? Your baby boy has been well...i sleep well .. early at night...tho sometimes i do stay up till 4 am just thinking about you~ not lying i swear , you know baby boy doesn't lieee..


..and i know it's over , yet i still think about you everyday, still feel my little troublemaker talking or sitting with me while i work, study or whatever~ 

Still feel my kitten snuggling upto me when I sleep..., 

still feel my mommy cheering me up whenever I am stressed or in trouble lol~ and i always sleep knowing mommy will take care of me~ 
 
And lastly i apologise for everything I did , all the pain i caused , no sorry or apology can ever undo it  and I'll live with what I lost ,
Never blame yourself for anything... You know i would never want that no matter what I said while being angry...

We aren't enemies, we never have to be..... remember when you feel like you have no one don't forget i have never forgotten about you... 
Funny thing if you remember I'm not that into punjabi and other songs , mostly english right? After you have left all my songs are hindi, punjabi and other languages..., always imagining us in them , wishing for things i wasn't able to do... feeling both sad and happy... , songs like. "Bairan, barsaat, for a reason , seesha, pal pal , Udi Udi and many more have become my morning routine, waking up to these and sleeping to these... 

 i am doing well for myself, still missing you everyday but you can stay worry free...im okay~ 

And see this website? I made it for your birthday i hope you liked it , i couldn't do more as i knew i had lost the right to be it...im not your anything now...so i can't do more even if i wanted it...~ grr don't forget to blow the candles 🤧 ( still love you) 

Bye bye~
shareText: A little birthday universe with candles, wishes and confetti — made just for you.
